   --  Production base URL.

   --  Number of scopes the security scheme defines.
   Scope_Count : constant := 1;

   type Scope_Index is range 1 .. Scope_Count;

      (Scope_1'Access);

with Ada.Containers.Vectors;

with UARP.JSON_Support;
with UARP.Types;

package UARP.Models is

   use UARP.Types;

   subtype JSON_Value is UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;

   --  Declares additionalProperties, so unmodelled keys must survive.
   type Envelope is record
      Id : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
      Has_Label : Boolean := False;
      Label : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
      --  Properties the server returned that this SDK does not model.
      Extra : JSON_Value := UARP.JSON_Support.Null_Value;
   end record;

   function To_JSON (Model : Envelope) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;
   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Envelope;

   --  Every shape of optionality the spec uses.
   type Thing is record
      Id : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
      --  Present but may be null.
      Has_Required_Nullable : Boolean := False;
      Required_Nullable : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
      Count : UARP.Types.Integer_Value := 0;
      Has_Optional_Plain : Boolean := False;
      Optional_Plain : UARP.Types.Float_Value := 0.0;
      Has_Optional_Nullable : Boolean := False;
      Optional_Nullable : Standard.Boolean := False;
      Has_Legacy_Nullable : Boolean := False;
      Legacy_Nullable : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value := UARP.JSON_Support.New_Object;
      Has_Created_At : Boolean := False;
      Created_At : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
      Has_Tags : Boolean := False;
      Tags : UARP.Types.Text_Vectors.Vector;
      Has_Free_Form : Boolean := False;
      Free_Form : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value := UARP.JSON_Support.New_Object;
      Has_Anything : Boolean := False;
      Anything : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value := UARP.JSON_Support.New_Object;
      Has_Deprecated_Field : Boolean := False;
      Deprecated_Field : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
      Has_Kind : Boolean := False;
      Kind : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
   end record;

   function To_JSON (Model : Thing) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;
   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Thing;

==> src/generated/uarp-models.adb <==
--  Code generated by @uarp/codegen from spec/openapi.json. DO NOT EDIT.

package body UARP.Models is

   package JS renames UARP.JSON_Support;

   function To_JSON (Model : Envelope) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value is
      Result : constant UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value := JS.New_Object;
   begin
      JS.Set (Result, "id", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Id));
      if Model.Has_Label then
         JS.Set (Result, "label", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Label));
      end if;
      return Result;
   end To_JSON;

   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Envelope is
      Result : Envelope;
   begin
      if JS.Present (Node, "id") then
         Result.Id := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "id"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "label") then
         Result.Has_Label := True;
         Result.Label := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "label"));
      end if;
      Result.Extra := Node;
      return Result;
   end From_JSON;

   function To_JSON (Model : Thing) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value is
      Result : constant UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value := JS.New_Object;
   begin
      JS.Set (Result, "id", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Id));
      if Model.Has_Required_Nullable then
         JS.Set (Result, "required_nullable", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Required_Nullable));
      end if;
      JS.Set (Result, "count", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Count));
      if Model.Has_Optional_Plain then
         JS.Set (Result, "optional_plain", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Optional_Plain));
      end if;
      if Model.Has_Optional_Nullable then
         JS.Set (Result, "optional_nullable", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Optional_Nullable));
      end if;
      if Model.Has_Legacy_Nullable then
         JS.Set (Result, "legacy_nullable", Model.Legacy_Nullable);
      end if;
      if Model.Has_Created_At then
         JS.Set (Result, "created_at", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Created_At));
      end if;
      if Model.Has_Tags then
         declare
            Items : JS.JSON_Array := JS.JSON.Empty_Array;
         begin
            for Element of Model.Tags loop
               JS.JSON.Append (Items, JS.JSON.Create (Element));
            end loop;
            JS.Set (Result, "tags", Items);
         end;
      end if;
      if Model.Has_Free_Form then
         JS.Set (Result, "free_form", Model.Free_Form);
      end if;
      if Model.Has_Anything then
         JS.Set (Result, "anything", Model.Anything);
      end if;
      if Model.Has_Deprecated_Field then
         JS.Set (Result, "deprecated_field", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Deprecated_Field));
      end if;
      if Model.Has_Kind then
         JS.Set (Result, "kind", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Kind));
      end if;
      return Result;
   end To_JSON;

   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Thing is
      Result : Thing;
   begin
      if JS.Present (Node, "id") then
         Result.Id := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "id"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "required_nullable") then
         Result.Has_Required_Nullable := True;
         Result.Required_Nullable := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "required_nullable"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "count") then
         Result.Count := JS.As_Integer (JS.Get_Value (Node, "count"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "optional_plain") then
         Result.Has_Optional_Plain := True;
         Result.Optional_Plain := JS.As_Float (JS.Get_Value (Node, "optional_plain"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "optional_nullable") then
         Result.Has_Optional_Nullable := True;
         Result.Optional_Nullable := JS.As_Boolean (JS.Get_Value (Node, "optional_nullable"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "legacy_nullable") then
         Result.Has_Legacy_Nullable := True;
         Result.Legacy_Nullable := JS.Get_Value (Node, "legacy_nullable");
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "created_at") then
         Result.Has_Created_At := True;
         Result.Created_At := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "created_at"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "tags") then
         Result.Has_Tags := True;
         declare
            Items : constant JS.JSON_Array := JS.Get_Array (Node, "tags");
         begin
            for Index in 1 .. JS.JSON.Length (Items) loop
               Result.Tags.Append (JS.As_Text (JS.JSON.Get (Items, Index)));
            end loop;
         end;
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "free_form") then
         Result.Has_Free_Form := True;
         Result.Free_Form := JS.Get_Value (Node, "free_form");
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "anything") then
         Result.Has_Anything := True;
         Result.Anything := JS.Get_Value (Node, "anything");
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "deprecated_field") then
         Result.Has_Deprecated_Field := True;
         Result.Deprecated_Field := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "deprecated_field"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "kind") then
         Result.Has_Kind := True;
         Result.Kind := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "kind"));
      end if;
      return Result;
   end From_JSON;

end UARP.Models;
